programmes.d: John Wayne, Constance Towers and William Holden star in this 1863, fact-based story about a Union mission to destroy a railroad junction deep within Confederate territory.

A confident oil baron and a determined cowboy are rivals for Oklahoma land and oil rights, and for the love of a pretty schoolteacher. The cowboy acts on behalf of the Indians, on whose land the oil is discovered.

Instruktøren Howard Hawks slår sig igen sammen med John Wayne, der leder en gruppe professionelle storvildtjægere i Afrika. Men de bruger ikke kugler - de fange farligt storvildt med stærkt reb og kameraer til zoologiske haver og cirkusattraktioner.
A cowboy competes with a gambling tycoon on the Barbary Coast for the hand of a beautiful dance-hall queen.
The Duke plays a young, ambitious pharmacist who moves into a brawling frontier town but locks horns with a local crime lord, bent on keeping the town for himself.
Den hårde marinesergent John Stryker er meget upopulær blandt mændene i sin deling, især de nye rekrutter, på grund af den brutale træning, han udsætter dem for.

A Viennese physician and his daughter, refugees from Hitler, become part of a group of North Dakota townspeople planning to relocate from the dust bowl to greener Oregon.
Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

A young boy sees his parents killed and his brother kidnapped by outlaws, while traveling west on a wagon train. As an adult, he leads a vigilante band seeking the outlaw band, even though his brother is now their scout.
